title.zh: 欧洲唯一现货比特币ETF获瑞士监管批准，BIT持续深化合规与多资产布局
title.en: 欧洲唯一现货比特币ETF获瑞士监管批准，BIT持续深化合规与多资产布局

current_state.zh: BIT's asset management arm received FINMA approval to list BBIT, described as Europe's first spot Bitcoin ETF, on the SIX Swiss Exchange in November, while BIT also expands equities and Swiss custody services.
current_state.en: BIT's asset management arm received FINMA approval to list BBIT, described as Europe's first spot Bitcoin ETF, on the SIX Swiss Exchange in November, while BIT also expands equities and Swiss custody services.
